## Reusable rules

1. **Gate only evaluator subtypes that are preview** For this Foundry evaluator change, the three non-rubric custom definition subtypes receive the evaluations_v1_preview requirement; the PR description says rubric definitions, shared types, generation machinery, and createVersion routes remain GA. Treat this as a scoped precedent, not a universal rule. *Scope:* Foundry evaluator definition model preview metadata *Inferred lesson.* Evidence: https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/46830, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/3230908e8441ff1757e7d6301992b97f1388e266/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/evaluators/models.tsp

2. **Keep SDK client locations aligned with evaluator availability** The relocation patch places rubric evaluator generation jobs on the root Evaluators client and custom preview upload operations on the Beta Evaluators client. This is a service-specific mapping, not a general client-location rule. *Scope:* Foundry evaluator SDK operation relocation *Inferred lesson.* Evidence: https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/3230908e8441ff1757e7d6301992b97f1388e266/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/sdk-common/ops-relocation-evaluators.tsp, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/3230908e8441ff1757e7d6301992b97f1388e266/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/sdk-common/ops-relocation-projects.tsp
